name: sudokumaker-custom-constraints
description: Worked examples of custom SudokuMaker constraint components.

standard.//: The .js files are constraint snippets pasted into SudokuMaker, not Node modules — linting them as Node reports the SudokuMaker API functions as unused and its globals as undefined. Lint the .mjs harness/probe code we run; the snippets stay judged by eye (see CODING_STANDARDS.md).
